static.reason: Tenant-bearing records and organization-context analyzers do not exist.

runtime.reason: No canonical tenant-scoped business records or execution paths exist.

eval.reason: No tenancy evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Manual schema and context review is required until purpose-built checks exist.

static.reason: Workspace ownership and domain dependency direction are checked; canonical object identity and schema ownership are not yet executable.

runtime.reason: Production domain identities and ownership schemas do not exist.

eval.reason: The planned synthesis scenario prohibits duplicating canonical facts but has no executable target.

review.reason: Package ownership is reviewable; future object ownership still requires schema review.

contracts.title: Commands and Queries Are Canonical Application Capabilities

static.reason: Import and package boundaries constrain adapters, but static checks cannot prove arbitrary handler semantics.

runtime.reason: No business Commands or Queries exist.

eval.reason: Canonical capability selection is defined but its target is not implemented.

review.reason: Adapter thinness and business-logic placement still require semantic review.

static.reason: Promotion eligibility is structurally and explicitly separate from authorization, but Authority adapter parity and bypass checks await the Authority Engine.

runtime.reason: The Authority Engine and consequential actions do not exist.

eval.reason: Authority and untrusted-content scenarios are registered but not executable.

review.reason: Enabled promotion grants no authority; every future consequential action still requires authority-boundary review until the Authority Engine and runtime parity tests exist.

contracts.title: Consequential Decisions and Actions Are Reconstructable

static.reason: Audit schemas and mutation restrictions do not exist.

runtime.reason: No consequential business decisions or append-only audit store exist.

eval.reason: No reconstructability evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Audit ownership is documented; record completeness requires future schema and behavior review.

contracts.title: Business Events Are Durable and Transactional

static.reason: Outbox schema and publish-boundary checks do not exist.

runtime.reason: No business events or transactional outbox exist.

eval.reason: Durability is primarily a deterministic runtime contract, not a judgment evaluation.

review.reason: Future event-producing changes require transactional-boundary review.

static.reason: Workflow-state ownership checks await workflow definitions.

runtime.reason: Temporal is scaffolded locally, but no Nexus workflow exists.

eval.reason: Restart and recovery are deterministic runtime concerns.

review.reason: Workflow versus canonical-state ownership is documented and remains a manual review gate.

contracts.title: External Side Effects Are Idempotent and Reconcilable

static.reason: Action Intent and idempotency metadata checks await side-effect implementations.

runtime.reason: No consequential external action exists.

eval.reason: Timeout/reconciliation expectations are registered but not executable.

review.reason: Every future external mutation requires idempotency/reconciliation review.

contracts.title: AI Tools Are Adapters, Not Business Logic

static.reason: AI-to-database and package dependencies are constrained; tool callback semantics still require review.

runtime.reason: No Alex runtime or AI tool adapters exist.

eval.reason: The scenario expects selection of a canonical application capability rather than shadow AI behavior.

review.reason: AI adapter thinness remains a semantic review requirement.

static.reason: Provider identifier searches and gateway boundaries await Model Gateway implementation.

runtime.reason: No Model Gateway or provider adapter exists.

eval.reason: No routing/profile evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Provider-neutrality and explicit live-profile review are documented.

static.reason: Context packet schemas and size budgets do not exist.

runtime.reason: No Context Engine or model request path exists.

eval.reason: Planned scenarios require bounded grounded evidence but targets are not implemented.

review.reason: Future model inputs require evidence-scope and permission review.

static.reason: Memory provenance and supersession schemas do not exist.

runtime.reason: No canonical business facts or memory retrieval exists.

eval.reason: A canonical-versus-memory conflict is registered and visibly not implemented.

review.reason: The truth hierarchy is documented; implementation semantics remain review-only.

contracts.title: Capability Exposure Is Minimal and Relevant

static.reason: Capability Registry and catalog diagnostics do not exist.

runtime.reason: No capability-exposure path exists.

eval.reason: Selection relevance is represented but cannot execute without the registry and target capability.

review.reason: Future AI surfaces require explicit capability-scope review.

contracts.title: Knowledge Retrieval Is Permission-Aware Before Model Access

static.reason: Knowledge index and permission-aware retrieval boundaries do not exist.

runtime.reason: No document retrieval or model-access pipeline exists.

eval.reason: Permission-negative retrieval evaluation is not yet defined.

review.reason: Retrieve-before-authorize designs are prohibited by documented review governance.

static.reason: The provider adapter package boundary exists; conformance and normalized-schema checks await adapters.

runtime.reason: No provider integration exists.

eval.reason: No adapter conformance evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Provider-to-canonical translation requires semantic review.

contracts.title: External Clients Are Portals, Not Nexus Replacements

static.reason: External client projection and principal-binding checks do not exist.

runtime.reason: No MCP or external client surface exists.

eval.reason: No external-client authority evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Future portal projection and authority scope require security/architecture review.

static.reason: Workspace Specification schema and registered grammar do not exist.

runtime.reason: No generated workspace runtime exists.

eval.reason: Structured composition expectations are registered but not executable.

review.reason: Arbitrary generated executable UI remains a documented prohibited pattern.

contracts.title: Visual Grammar Is Versioned and Compatible

static.reason: Visual Grammar schema/version compatibility checks do not exist.

runtime.reason: No saved workspace grammar or migration exists.

eval.reason: No compatibility evaluation target exists.

review.reason: Future grammar changes require explicit compatibility review.

static.reason: Shadow observations explicitly exclude attention and notification outcomes, while actual attention, activity, and approval schemas do not yet exist.

runtime.reason: No Watch or interruption behavior exists.

eval.reason: Low-materiality batching is defined but not executable.

review.reason: Promotion evidence is documented as non-interruptive; future notifications still require materiality and role review.

contracts.title: Business Audit, AI Activity, Provider Traces, and Technical Observability Stay Distinct

static.reason: Technical observability now has a separate package contract, privacy-safe schema, redaction boundary, and explicit prohibition on becoming Business Audit, AI Activity, or provider traces; those other record types remain unimplemented.

runtime.reason: Local tests enforce structured technical correlation and privacy behavior across API and worker paths; Business Audit, AI Activity, and provider trace runtime separation cannot be fully exercised until those records exist.

eval.reason: No layer-separation evaluation target exists.

review.reason: The technical telemetry audience, sensitivity, propagation, and future exporter boundary are documented; cross-record correlation still requires review as other layers arrive.

static.reason: The repository statically enforces secret and environment policy, defines separate cloud roots, restricts dev federation by immutable repository/owner identity and main ref without a key, and applies deterministic technical-log redaction without recording request bodies, credentials, or secret environment values.

runtime.reason: Destructive local database operations reject non-local targets, tests reject network, observability privacy tests protect common secret keys, and the manual dev identity smoke verifies short-lived access without deployment. Application cloud roots remain unapplied, so deployed environment isolation is not proven.

eval.reason: Environment isolation is enforced through deterministic configuration, runtime, and security review.

review.reason: State, plan, IAM, resource, cost, dev workload identity, and keyless rotation rules are documented; deployment-resource IAM, secret payload handling, and staging/production evidence remain future gates.

contracts.title: Migration Preserves Provenance and Is Repeatable

static.reason: Committed v2 schema migrations are governed; source provenance and v1 transformation mapping do not exist.

runtime.reason: Local schema migration repeatability is proven, not a source-to-v2 migration pipeline.

eval.reason: Migration reconciliation is primarily deterministic runtime evidence.

review.reason: Future source mapping, reconciliation, and failure handling require migration review.

static.reason: The root operating guide and architecture map make commands, ownership, boundaries, contract status, infrastructure procedures, and safety rules discoverable; semantic completeness remains an ongoing review property.

runtime.reason: A clean repository can prove its documented gates, local correlation model, and promotion-control smoke behavior without infrastructure or external providers, but future work boundaries remain an ongoing obligation.

eval.reason: Agent legibility is primarily repository governance rather than product judgment evaluation.

review.reason: The operating guide defines escalation and completion rules, and the WIF runbook makes dev identity prerequisites and trust boundaries reproducible; architecture, infrastructure, telemetry, promotion/authority separation, deployment IAM, exposure, cost, and work-packet scope still require explicit review.

contracts.title: Tiering Does Not Fork the Product

static.reason: Entitlement schemas and anti-fork checks do not exist.

runtime.reason: No plans or entitlements exist.

eval.reason: Product-tier consistency is primarily deterministic schema/runtime evidence.

review.reason: Future tier changes require one-platform schema and behavior review.

static.reason: Evaluation reports expose provider/cost metadata and enforce zero-cost defaults; production Cost Governor telemetry does not exist.

runtime.reason: No model routing, provider use, or organization/workflow cost telemetry exists.

eval.reason: No AI-economics product scenario exists; harness cost fields are not product enforcement.

review.reason: Future live evaluation and model routing require intentional observable cost review.
